1.word_for_word: ऊन-पञ्चाशत्तमे तु गत्वाक्रूरो गजाह्वयम् । — In the fifty-ninth century, Akrūra went to Gajahvāya.; राज्ञः स्व-भ्रातृ-पुत्रेषु बुद्ध्वा वैषम्यम् आगमत् ॥ — The king realized that there was a difference between his brothers and sons.; पौरवेन्द्राणां यशोभिस् तत् कृत-देव-ब्राह्मणायतनादिभिर् अङ्कितम् ॥१॥ — It is marked with the fame of the kings of the ancients by the temples of the gods and brahmins and so on.
1.translation: In the fifty-ninth century, Akrūra went to Gajahvāya. The king realized that there was a difference between his brothers and sons. It is marked with the fame of the kings of the ancients by the temples of the gods and brahmins and so on.

2.word_for_word: बाह्लीक-पुत्रः सोमदत्तः । — Somadatta, the son of Bahlik.; भारद्वाजो द्रोणः । — Bharadwaja is Drona.; गौतमः कृपः ॥२॥ — Gautama is a merciful man.
2.translation: Somadatta, the son of Bahlik. Bharadwaja is Drona. Gautama is a merciful man.

4.word_for_word: दुष्प्रजस्यासत्-पुत्रस्य अल्प-सारस्य मन्द-धृतेः स्वलानां कर्णादीनां छन्दम् इच्छाम् अनुवर्तितुं शीलं यस्येति तथा तस्य ॥४॥ — That is the characteristic of a man who has difficult progeny, who is a wicked son, who has little essence, who has slow patience, who has the characteristics of following the desires of his own wives, such as Karna.
4.translation: That is the characteristic of a man who has difficult progeny, who is a wicked son, who has little essence, who has slow patience, who has the characteristics of following the desires of his own wives, such as Karna.

5.word_for_word: तेजः प्रभावः । — Teja is the effect.; ओजः शस्त्रादि-नैपुणम् । — Oja is skilled in weapons and other things.; वीर्यं शौर्यम् । — Semen is courage.; न सहद्भिर् असहमानैः । — Not by those who tolerate it and those who do not tolerate it.; चिकीर्षितम् इत उपरि कर्तुम् इष्टम् ॥५॥ — I wanted to do what I wanted to do here above.
5.translation: Teja is the effect. Oja is skilled in weapons and other things. Semen is courage. Not by those who tolerate it and those who do not tolerate it. I wanted to do what I wanted to do here above.

6.word_for_word: गरस्य विषस्य दानादि । — giving poison to the throat, etc.; अपेशलम् अन्याय्यम् । — Apeshall is unfair.; तेज ओज इत्य्-आदि सर्वं कथयाम् आस ॥६॥ — Teja, Oja, etc., were all told.
6.translation: giving poison to the throat, etc. Apeshall is unfair. Teja, Oja, etc., were all told.

7.word_for_word: तत्-कथनात् पूर्वतनं पृथाया वृत्तम् आह---पृथा त्व् इति । — Before that statement, he argues that the story of Pritha is preceded by the story of Pritha.; अश्रूणां कला लेशा ययोस् ते ईक्षणे यस्याः सा ॥७॥ — The art of tears is the trace of tears in your eyes.
7.translation: Before that statement, he argues that the story of Pritha is preceded by the story of Pritha. The art of tears is the trace of tears in your eyes.

8.word_for_word: अपि किम् । — Even what.; जामयः कुल-स्त्रियः ॥८॥ — The wives are the women of the family.
8.translation: Even what. The wives are the women of the family.

9.word_for_word: पैतृ-ष्वस्रेयान् मत्-पुत्रान् ॥९॥ — My sons, the best of my fathers and sisters.
9.translation: My sons, the best of my fathers and sisters.

10.word_for_word: शोचन्तीं मां वाक्यैः सान्त्वयिष्यति किम् ॥१०॥ — What will he console me with words as I am grieving?
10.translation: What will he console me with words as I am grieving?

11.word_for_word: हे महा-योगिन् महान् योग उपायो मायाख्योऽस्यास्तीति । — O great yogi, there is a great yogic means of this called maya.; हे विश्वात्मन् सर्वान्तर्यामिन् । — O Soul of the universe, all-pervading.; हे विश्व-भावन विश्व-पालक । — O world-bearing world-keeper.; प्रपन्नां शरणागताम् । — She surrendered to him and took refuge in him.; अवसीदतीं क्लिश्यन्तीम् ॥११॥ — depressed and tormented.
11.translation: O great yogi, there is a great yogic means of this called maya. O Soul of the universe, all-pervading. O world-bearing world-keeper. She surrendered to him and took refuge in him. depressed and tormented.

12.word_for_word: आपवर्गिकान् मोक्ष-प्रदात् ॥१२॥ — He gave liberation to the liberated.
12.translation: He gave liberation to the liberated.

13.word_for_word: शुद्धाय धर्मात्मने । — To the pure and righteous soul.; ब्रह्मणेऽपरिच्छिन्नाय । — to the inseparable Brahman.; परमात्मने जीव-सखाय । — To the Supreme Soul, the friend of the living beings.; योगेश्वरायाणिमादि-युक्ताय । — O Lord of Yoga, endowed with Anima and others.; योगाय ज्ञानात्मने ॥१३॥ — Yoga, the Self of Knowledge.
13.translation: To the pure and righteous soul. to the inseparable Brahman. To the Supreme Soul, the friend of the living beings. O Lord of Yoga, endowed with Anima and others. Yoga, the Self of Knowledge.

14.word_for_word: प्रपितामही पितामहः पाण्डुस् तस्य भार्या रुरोद ॥१४॥ — His great-grandmother and grandfather Pandu's wife wept.
14.translation: His great-grandmother and grandfather Pandu's wife wept.

15.word_for_word: पृथया सह समं दुःखं सुखं च यस्य सः । — He who has equal pain and pleasure with the earth.; तस्याः पुत्राणाम् उत्पत्ति-हेतुभिर् जनकैर् धर्मानिलेन्द्रादिभिस् तत् कथनैर् इत्य् अर्थः ॥१५॥ — This means that the causes of the origin of her sons were described by the fathers, Dharma, Indra and others.
15.translation: He who has equal pain and pleasure with the earth. This means that the causes of the origin of her sons were described by the fathers, Dharma, Indra and others.

16.word_for_word: बन्धुभिः राम-कृष्णादिभिः सौहृदेनोदितम् उक्तं यत् तद् अवदद् इति ॥१६॥ — He told them whatever his relatives Rama and Krishna had said in a friendly manner.
16.translation: He told them whatever his relatives Rama and Krishna had said in a friendly manner.

17.word_for_word: भ्रातर्य् उपरत इति । — It is said that the brother is up.; पाण्डोः पुत्रेषु सत्सु राजासनं त्वम् आस्थित इति कटाक्षः ॥१७॥ — "You have taken the throne among the virtuous sons of Pandu," he said with a glance.
17.translation: It is said that the brother is up. "You have taken the throne among the virtuous sons of Pandu," he said with a glance.

18.word_for_word: भवतु तथाप्य् एवं वर्तमानः श्रेयोऽवाप्स्यसीत्य् आह---धर्मेणेति ॥१८॥ — Let it be so, and yet by thus acting you will attain good, he argues, by virtue of righteousness.
18.translation: Let it be so, and yet by thus acting you will attain good, he argues, by virtue of righteousness.

19.word_for_word: तमो नरकम् इहैव महद्-दुःखम् इति भावः ॥१९॥ — This means that darkness is hell and that there is great suffering here.
19.translation: This means that darkness is hell and that there is great suffering here.

20.word_for_word: नन्व् आत्म-जानात्म-जादिषु कथं समत्वं स्यात् तत्राह---नेह चेति । — Now, how can there be equality between self-knowledge and self-born?; अत्यन्तं नित्यं संवासः सम्यक् स्थितिः ॥२०॥ — The most constant dwelling is the perfect position.
20.translation: Now, how can there be equality between self-knowledge and self-born? The most constant dwelling is the perfect position.

21.word_for_word: तत्र तावद् उत्पत्ति-मरणयोः सुख-दुखयोश् च केनापि साहित्यं नास्तीत्य् आह---एक इति ॥२१॥ — There is no literature by any means on the subject of origin and death, happiness and pain, and he argues that there is one.
21.translation: There is no literature by any means on the subject of origin and death, happiness and pain, and he argues that there is one.

22.word_for_word: किं च यदा च सह संवसन्ति तदापि क्लेशोपार्जित-वित्तापहारितया पुत्रा नाम शत्रव एव ज्ञेया इत्य् आह---अधर्मेति । — Moreover, even when they live together, they should be regarded as enemies by the name of their sons, who have been robbed of their hard-earned wealth.; सम्भोजनीयाः पोष्याः । — They are to be fed and nourished.; पुत्रादय इति व्यपदेशैर् अल्प-मेधसो मूढस्य वित्तं हरन्ति । — By pretending to be sons and others, they take away the wealth of a fool of little intelligence.; जलौकसो मत्स्य-जीवनहूतानि जलानि यथा तत् पुत्रा हरन्ति तद्वद् इति ॥२२॥ — Just as the sons of the aquatic animals carry away the waters that are called for the life of fish
22.translation: Moreover, even when they live together, they should be regarded as enemies by the name of their sons, who have been robbed of their hard-earned wealth. They are to be fed and nourished. By pretending to be sons and others, they take away the wealth of a fool of little intelligence. Just as the sons of the aquatic animals carry away the waters that are called for the life of fish

23.word_for_word: किं च यान् एवं पुष्णाति ते धनम् आदाय मृता जीवन्तोऽपि वा तं परित्यजन्तीत्य् आह---पुष्णातीति । — What is more, he argues that those whom he thus nourishes take the wealth and abandon it, whether they are dead or alive.; स्व-बुद्ध्या स्वीया इत्य् अभिमानेन रायोऽर्थाः अकृतार्थम् अप्राप्त-भोगम् ॥२३॥ — By pride in his own intellect he thinks that he is his own and his wealth is not fulfilled and he enjoys it unattained.
23.translation: What is more, he argues that those whom he thus nourishes take the wealth and abandon it, whether they are dead or alive. By pride in his own intellect he thinks that he is his own and his wealth is not fulfilled and he enjoys it unattained.

24.word_for_word: स पुनः पापैक-पाथेयो नरकं विशतीत्य् आह---स्वयम् इति । — He again argues that the path of sin enters hell by himself.; असिद्धार्थोऽपूर्ण-मनोरथः ॥२४॥ — Incomplete purpose and unfulfilled desire.
24.translation: He again argues that the path of sin enters hell by himself. Incomplete purpose and unfulfilled desire.

25.word_for_word: स्वप्नश् च माया च मनो-रथश् च तत्तेन तुल्यम् । — Dreams, illusion and the chariot of the mind are equal to that.; आयम्य नियम्य । — I am regulating.; शान्तः सन् समो भवेति ॥२५॥ — He should be calm and equal.
25.translation: Dreams, illusion and the chariot of the mind are equal to that. I am regulating. He should be calm and equal.

26.word_for_word: हे दान-पते अक्रूर । — O lord of charity, Akrura.; न तृप्याम्य् अलम् इति न मन्ये ॥२६॥ — I don’t think I’m satisfied enough.
26.translation: O lord of charity, Akrura. I don’t think I’m satisfied enough.

27.word_for_word: सूनृता प्रिया वाक् चलेऽस्थिरे हृदि न स्थीयते न तिष्ठतीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that a sweet, dear word does not remain in a moving, unsteady heart.; सुदामा पर्वतस् तत्र भवा विद्युद् इव । — Be there on Mount Sudama, like lightning.; तस्मिन् स्फटिक-शिलामये सहसैवाति-स्फुरिता विद्युद् यथा लीयते तद्वद् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that it is like lightning that suddenly melts into that crystalline rock.; यद्वा सुदामा माला तस्या इयं सौदामनी । — Or rather, the Sudama garland is hers, and this is the Saudamani.; मालाकारेत्य् अर्थः ॥२७॥ — garland-shaped, meaning.
27.translation: This means that a sweet, dear word does not remain in a moving, unsteady heart. Be there on Mount Sudama, like lightning. This means that it is like lightning that suddenly melts into that crystalline rock. Or rather, the Sudama garland is hers, and this is the Saudamani. garland-shaped, meaning.

28.word_for_word: नन्व् एवं जानतोऽपि कथम् अयं मोह इति चेद् अत आह---ईश्वरस्येति । — If, then, we ask how this delusion is, even though we know this, he argues that it is of God.; विधिं विधानं । — The method is the legislation.; मायाम् इति यावत् ॥२८॥ — Maya, that is, the illusion.
28.translation: If, then, we ask how this delusion is, even though we know this, he argues that it is of God. The method is the legislation. Maya, that is, the illusion.

29.word_for_word: अतस् तम् एव नमस्यति । — Therefore, he will bow down to Him.; य इति । — Ya is the.; दुर्विमर्श-पठया अवितर्क्य-मार्गया । — By reading it in a difficult and irrational way.; गुणान् कर्माणि तत्-फलानि च विभजतेति विविच्य ददाति । — He distinguishes between the modes of nature, actions and the fruits of these activities.; दुरवबोधो यो विहारस् तस्य क्रीडा स एव तन्त्रं प्रधानं मुख्यं कारणं यस्य संसार-चक्रस्यात एव तस्य गतिर् यस्मात् तस्मै नम इति ॥२९॥ — The pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead which are difficult to understand are His pastimes He is the principal and chief cause of the cycle of material existence He is the destination of the Supreme Personality of Godhead from whom I offer my obeisances.
29.translation: Therefore, he will bow down to Him. Ya is the. By reading it in a difficult and irrational way. He distinguishes between the modes of nature, actions and the fruits of these activities. The pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead which are difficult to understand are His pastimes He is the principal and chief cause of the cycle of material existence He is the destination of the Supreme Personality of Godhead from whom I offer my obeisances.
